Terms.Name: Emergency code
Terms.Description: Rules of operation during a priority emergency

Terms.Name: Overload protocol
Terms.Description: A directive to use maximum force to contain or neutralize the situation

Terms.Name: Prosecution code

Terms.Name: Sacrifice code
